svg.title: Electoral map – The House today (mockup)
svg.text: Aggregated opinion polling for the next Australian federal election,
The current House of Representatives, last changed 25 June 2026 · 8,940 polling places
These figures are the 2025 election’s adjusted for
changes since then. One Nation has taken two seats
from the Coalition and two independents co-founded
swing to Labor at the 2025 election
with every member in their seat
Zoom in, or choose a seat, to see its polling places
